caption: Oudegracht, Utrecht
composition: Two-level canal, wharf cellars at the water and the street above · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Along the Oudegracht the canal has two levels: arched brick cellars open onto a low wharf at the water, and the street with gabled houses sits a storey higher. A bridge crosses in the middle distance. The Dom Tower is not the subject. It is clear, about 15.1°C, wind near 9.0 km/h. Sunset was 19:31, so the wharves are lamp-lit.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Oudegracht wharves in Utrecht on a clear night, with cellar arches at the water
